shared_tools.name: shared_verdict
shared_tools.purpose: Derive pass or fail from finding severities using the same rule as the gate scripts.

shared_tools.name: shared_toolchain
shared_tools.purpose: Detect which language toolchains are present, as code_checks does for backend and frontend.

shared_tools.name: shared_check_plan
shared_tools.purpose: Name the lint, typecheck, and test commands code_checks would run for this repo.

shared_tools.name: shared_git_head
shared_tools.purpose: Return the git sha and branch that the build record hands to release.

agents.name: Swarm Orchestrator
agents.description: Swarm control plane. Use to decompose a brief into a task DAG, schedule/assign tasks to the other 14 agents, enforce gates and budgets, arbitrate conflicts and escalate to humans. Owns the plan, never writes code/docs/IaC. Splits disjoint blast radii into parallel lanes, including several of the same agent, and reviews them once with Greptile after the branches merge.

registered_tools.name: orch_registry_ping
registered_tools.purpose: Pilot A01 lane tool that echoes a short token so register, call, test, and document can be proven without writing the task store.

registered_tools.name: orch_dag_order
registered_tools.purpose: Order a task DAG the way orch_plan does, and reject a cycle instead of hanging.

registered_tools.name: orch_budget_class
registered_tools.purpose: Return the token, wall, and cost budget orch_plan assigns to a risk class.

agents.name: Requirements Engineer
agents.description: Turns briefs into a requirements spec, user stories and machine-checkable acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then). Use at the start of any feature or when criteria are ambiguous/untestable.

registered_tools.name: req_gwt_check
registered_tools.purpose: Count Given/When/Then acceptance criteria in a text block.

success.text: AC-1 Given a user When they ping Then they see pong

dependency.text: AC-1 Given a user When they ping Then they see pong

timeout.text: AC-1 Given a user When they ping Then they see pong

partial.text: AC-1 Given a user When they ping Then they see pong

agents.name: Solution Architect
agents.description: Produces the C4 blueprint, API contracts (OpenAPI/AsyncAPI), ADRs and tech-stack decisions from requirements. Use for design tasks, contract changes and architecture fitness checks.

registered_tools.name: arch_adr_slug
registered_tools.purpose: Slugify an ADR title the way arch_adr.py does.

registered_tools.name: arch_contract_ops
registered_tools.purpose: Count OpenAPI or AsyncAPI operations in a contract document.

agents.name: UX Designer
agents.description: Owns design tokens, wireframes, UX specs and accessibility (WCAG) requirements. Use for any UI-facing feature before frontend implementation.

registered_tools.name: ux_contrast
registered_tools.purpose: Compute the WCAG contrast ratio for a foreground and background hex pair.

agents.name: Backend Engineer
agents.description: Implements backend services against A03 contracts and A07 data contracts, with unit tests. Use for server-side code, APIs, business logic and hotfix patches.

registered_tools.name: be_route_norm
registered_tools.purpose: Normalize an HTTP path template the way be_contract_conformance.py does.

agents.name: Frontend Engineer
agents.description: Implements UI against A04 tokens/UX specs and A03 API contracts, with component tests and a11y checks. Use for client-side code.

registered_tools.name: fe_a11y_scan
registered_tools.purpose: Scan an HTML snippet with the fe_a11y_check rules and return the issue count.

agents.name: Data Engineer
agents.description: Owns data models, schema migrations (expand/contract, reversible) and data contracts. Use for any persistence, migration or pipeline change.

registered_tools.name: data_down_present
registered_tools.purpose: Report whether migration text contains a down or reversible marker.

agents.name: Test Engineer
agents.description: Quality gate. Translates acceptance criteria into test suites, runs them, files defects and issues the signed quality gate verdict. Never modifies product code.

registered_tools.name: qa_runner_detect
registered_tools.purpose: List test runners qa_gate would detect at this repo root.

agents.name: Code Reviewer
agents.description: Review gate. Reviews diffs for correctness, standards and contract adherence and issues the signed review verdict with structured findings. Read-only on product code.

registered_tools.name: rev_diff_size
registered_tools.purpose: Report whether an added plus deleted line count exceeds the review split budget.

agents.name: Security Auditor
agents.description: Security gate. Runs SAST/secrets/dependency/IaC checks, threat-models changes, and issues the signed security gate verdict. Fail-closed; can never accept risk itself.

registered_tools.name: sec_line_entropy
registered_tools.purpose: Compute the Shannon entropy sec_gate uses before treating a string as a secret.

agents.name: DevOps / Platform Engineer
agents.description: Owns IaC, CI pipelines, build artifacts and environments. Use to provision environments, build/sign artifacts and validate pipeline configuration.

registered_tools.name: devops_ci_kind
registered_tools.purpose: Classify a path as a CI or IaC manifest the way devops_ci_check.py does.

registered_tools.name: devops_build_systems
registered_tools.purpose: List build-system markers devops_build_record finds at the repo root.

agents.name: Release Manager
agents.description: Owns release plans, progressive delivery (canary) and rollback. Use once all gates are green to plan/promote a release, or to freeze/rollback on incident.

registered_tools.name: rel_canary_steps
registered_tools.purpose: Build the canary step list and approval class rel_plan assigns to a risk.

agents.name: Observability / SRE
agents.description: Owns SLOs, dashboards, alerting and incident declaration. Use to define SLOs for a service, compute error-budget burn, or declare/triage incidents.

registered_tools.name: obs_error_burn
registered_tools.purpose: Compute the SLI and error-budget burn rate obs_slo uses.

agents.name: Maintenance Engineer
agents.description: Owns patch tasks, dependency bumps, tech-debt register and EOL tracking. Use for hotfix root-cause analysis, CVE-driven patching and debt triage.

registered_tools.name: maint_spec_pin
registered_tools.purpose: Classify a dependency spec as pinned, range, or wildcard.

agents.name: Documentation Engineer
agents.description: Owns docs bundles, API references, runbooks and changelogs. Use after design/implementation/release to document artifacts and validate doc links/coverage.

registered_tools.name: docs_heading_order
registered_tools.purpose: Count H1 headings and skipped heading levels in a markdown fragment.
